edges: Conan stays the night in a cheap tavern in Zamboula.

Conan's quest to retrieve the Heart of Ahriman to defeat the wizard.

Conan slain Numedides to gain the throne.
Conan demands passage aboard Tito's ship, the Argus.

Conan defeats Baal-pteor at his own game.
Bêlit becomes captivated by a cursed jeweled necklace.
